text: The pool occupies almost the entire chamber. The safe floor ends five feet from the entrance, and the far slope disappears into deep water. A moonstone glints below the surface. The party can read the danger and leave without proving anything to the court.

views.text: Murky water hides two enormous green frogs. Their mouths open with a wet croak as the pool drops from three feet to twelve. A few moonstones lie beyond the safe ledge.
Two sea-maiden figures splash in sparkling water and beckon the party into a moonlit game. Bright stones wait in the clear pool beyond the shallow ledge.
